title: PCB line impedances from their cross-sections: an outer microstrip, a centred stripline and a coupled stripline pair
source: Hammerstad and Jensen, IEEE MTT-S 1980 pp. 407–409 (microstrip, a fit within about 1 %); S. B. Cohn, IRE Trans. MTT 2(2):52–57, 1954 (stripline, exact for a strip of no thickness) and IRE Trans. MTT 3(5):29–38, 1955 (coupled striplines' even and odd impedances, exact). Reference values evaluated independently of EMCraft from the published formulas (arithmetic–geometric means for the elliptic integrals' ratios): W 0.35 mm on h 0.2 mm, εr 4.3; W 0.2 mm centred between planes 0.8 mm apart, εr 4.3; two such strips 0.2 mm apart.

quantities.reason: The finite elements' quasi-static Z0 (its lid 20 h up) against Hammerstad and Jensen's fit, itself within about 1 % of exact.
Cohn's exact zero-thickness stripline; the box's side walls and the grid within 1 %.

quantities.quantity: coupled stripline differential impedance (2 Z_odd), ohms
